rows.name: HF_TOKEN

problems.statement: The scripts pass the token to `AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained` when they load the tokenizer.
problems.code_says: The variable is the second source. gen.py takes tokenizer.hf_token of its YAML input first; tokenizer.py takes --hf-token first. An empty HF_TOKEN counts as absent, and the scripts then read HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN.

The httpx library reads the name inside t/proxy/tools/capture.py. The last cell of the same row says that capture.py uses the proxy variables.

notes: Short version: 12 rows checked against commit 7eddde7895. 1 row was wrong (ALL_PROXY), 8 were imprecise, 3 were correct. All 12 rows changed, 3 of them only for house rules. Changes by kind. (1) The 7 rows with Tron = Sets now start the Where cell with 'No reader in Tron.' in place of 'Nothing in Tron.' (2) Three rows reported a source comment (HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS, TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM, TRANSFORMERS_NO_ADVISORY_WARNINGS). The sentence is gone. The rows now state that os.environ.setdefault keeps a value from the caller. (3) 'Nix derivation' became 'Nix build' in TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE, as the earlier finding proposed. The code confirms the name tron-test-model-traces. (4) ALL_PROXY: the Tron cell changed from Sets to Reads and sets, and the Where cell now matches all_proxy. The code confirms the earlier finding: httpx reads both letter cases through urllib getproxies. (5) http_proxy: 'Two test files set it' became the two file names. (6) HF_TOKEN: the last cell now gives the order of the token sources. The Where cell gained one sentence about the read by the huggingface_hub library inside bin/get_model. That sentence follows the practice of the proxy rows and of LNAME. Remove it if section 7 must list only files that name the variable. Library behavior is not in the checkout. I read it from copies outside the checkout: the Python standard library (3.10 on this host and a 3.12.7 copy), httpx 0.28.1 (the version in t/proxy/uv.lock) and huggingface_hub 1.13.0 (the version in bin/uv.lock), the last two in the uv package cache. Rows outside this chunk with the same defects, seen in the document: NO_PROXY has Tron = Unsets although the same libraries read it, and its last cell holds '2 tests'. no_proxy holds 'Two test files set it'. HTTPS_PROXY says 'HTTPS requests of Python tools go through the proxy' without the lower-case and no_proxy conditions. The index of the checkout holds staged changes (README.env-vars.md added, AGENTS.md and README.md modified). They were there before this check. I changed nothing in the checkout.
